name: VPN
description: VPN status in the bar and a panel to connect and switch, across whichever VPN tools are installed: Proton VPN, Mullvad, Windscribe and NordVPN through their CLIs, and NetworkManager's OpenVPN, WireGuard, OpenConnect and VPNC profiles. One tunnel at a time; the public exit address over HTTPS on connection changes only. Adopted from t1nk33r.vpn (jkoestinger/omarchy-vpn with the NordVPN plugin merged in, MIT); off by default

refreshIntervalSec.description: Seconds between status reads of the shown VPN tools (5-600, in steps of 5)

preferredBackend.description: Tool the panel opens on: Auto (the connected one, else the first found), Proton VPN, Mullvad, Windscribe, NordVPN or NetworkManager

favoriteCountries.description: Two-letter codes listed first for Proton VPN, Mullvad and NordVPN; Windscribe matches region names and their leading words

hiddenBackends.description: Tools the widget ignores (comma separated): proton, mullvad, windscribe, nordvpn, networkmanager; also set from the panel's gear

nordvpnAutoConnectCountry.description: Two-letter code NordVPN's connect-on-startup uses; empty lets NordVPN pick
